title: Unit 3 Stoichiometry Test
subject: chemistry
variation_policy: Preserve the exact 7-question constructed-response stoichiometry layout and mark emphasis while changing compounds, values, and contexts.

section_plans.title: Foundational Stoichiometry Calculations
section_plans.instructions: Show all work. Include units and use appropriate significant digits.

prebuilt_questions.stem: Calculate the amount of substance in moles for 5.41 x 10^22 formula units of calcium nitrate, Ca(NO3)2(s).
Calculate the mass of 1.20 mol of potassium phosphate, K3PO4(s).
How many oxygen atoms are present in 2.25 mol of sulfur dioxide, SO2(g)?

section_plans.title: Composition and Reaction Stoichiometry
section_plans.instructions: Show a complete stoichiometric setup. Write and balance any required chemical equation before solving.

prebuilt_questions.stem: A compound is 48.6% carbon, 8.16% hydrogen, and 43.2% oxygen by mass. Its molar mass is 74.1 g/mol. Determine the molecular formula of the compound.
prebuilt_questions.answer_hint: Empirical formula C3H6O2; molecular formula C3H6O2

prebuilt_questions.stem: In excess oxygen, phosphorus reacts to form tetraphosphorus decoxide, P4O10(s). Calculate the mass of P4O10 produced when 6.20 g of P4(s) is used.
prebuilt_questions.answer_hint: 14.2 g P4O10 approximately after using P4 + 5O2 -> P4O10

prebuilt_questions.stem: Sulfuric acid reacts with sodium hydroxide to produce sodium sulfate and water. If 4.90 g of H2SO4(aq) reacts completely with excess NaOH(aq), what mass of Na2SO4(s) is produced? Write a balanced chemical equation for the reaction.

section_plans.title: Lab Yield Analysis
section_plans.instructions: Use the data provided to determine theoretical yield and percent yield. Show your setup clearly.

prebuilt_questions.stem: Use the lab data below to determine the percentage yield of lead(II) iodide, PbI2(s), produced when excess potassium iodide is added to lead(II) nitrate solution. Lab data: mass of Pb(NO3)2 used = 1.36 g; mass of clean, dry filter paper = 1.08 g; mass of dry precipitate and filter paper = 2.50 g. Write the balanced chemical equation for the reaction.
prebuilt_questions.answer_hint: Pb(NO3)2 + 2KI -> PbI2 + 2KNO3; actual precipitate mass = 1.42 g; theoretical yield is about 1.89 g PbI2; percentage yield is about 75.1%

generation_constraints: Generate exactly 7 constructed-response questions across the three sections.
Include at least one formula-units or particles to moles conversion.
Include at least one moles-to-mass calculation.
Include at least one atoms or particles counting question.
Include at least one balanced-equation stoichiometry problem that asks for a product mass or amount.
Include one percent-yield lab problem based on measured precipitate data.
